verdict.rationale: The evidence only covers reviewing and deleting Gemini activity via My Activity (gemini-docs-31) and privacy settings for Live audio (gemini-docs-37, gemini-docs-38), but there is no mention of exporting chat history or account data (e.g., via Google Takeout or a dedicated export tool). missing for 10: any documentation of an export/download feature for chat history or account data, independent confirmation of export completeness.
